description: Opus BB unit B13: OHKO accuracy against a semi-invulnerable target. Mamoswine (Ice/Ground) digs in the setup turn. Then Jolly Machamp (No Guard) outspeeds it and uses Sheer Cold on it underground: No Guard's `onAnyInvulnerability` lets the move through, and hitStepAccuracy's OHKO branch skips the level and Ice-type check for a semi-invulnerable target (`if (!target.isSemiInvulnerable())`) and keeps the move's 30 accuracy, which No Guard's `Accuracy` handler turns into a hit: Mamoswine faints. Golurk (No Guard) uses Sheer Cold on Glaceon above ground: an Ice type is immune to Sheer Cold whatever No Guard does.
